section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1999
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA – 1999 N.C.R.B.,(M.H.A.) 2.10.2 As in the past, ‘Hanging’ was the predominant means for committing suicide, 18,149 males and 9,729 females brought end to their lives in 1999, using this method. Large number of victims from Arunachal Pradesh (80.4%), A & N Islands (80.3%) and Meghalaya (76.8%) terminated their lives by hanging. The following table presents the State and UT-wise percentage share of suicide victims who adopted ‘Hanging’ and ‘Poisoning’ as the means to end their lives.
